title: Topic 2
japanese_text:
A：彼女と別れたんだって？
B：うん。最近<u>息をつく</u>暇もないくらい仕事が忙しくて。会う<u>頻度</u>も減って、振られちゃった。今は全てを<u>放り出して</u>世界の<u>果て</u>まで飛んで行きたい気分…。
english_translation: A: I heard you and your girlfriend broke up? B: Yes. I've been so busy with work that I haven't had time to catch my breath lately. I didn't see her with as much frequency, and so she dumped me. Now I feel like tossing away everything and flying to the ends of the world...

annotated_words.meaning_en: catch a breath, take a short rest
